description: Get the user's OWN connected Shopify store audit — the deep 12-category report SeoAiX runs INSIDE the app using the store's real catalog, performance and analytics (technical, performance, on-page, schema, AEO, analytics, e-commerce, etc.) — far beyond what crawling a URL can see. Takes no url. Needs an SeoAiX API key (free at seoaix.com → Settings) + a connected store: pass the key either as `Authorization: Bearer inxy_sk_…` or as the `api_key` argument.

api_key.description: Your SeoAiX API key (inxy_sk_…). Optional if already sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

name: get_my_store_audit
